metadata.question: Did sea surface temperatures near the coast of La Jolla, California exceed 23 degrees Celcius on August 1, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use SST dataset like NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1 (daily, 0.25° resolution) or HYCOM - Date: 2018-08-01 - Location: La Jolla, California coast (~32.85°N, -117.27°W) 2. Masking strategy: - SST data typically has quality flags or uses masked values for land - No cloud masking needed for SST - Check for valid ocean pixels only 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If SST value is None or NaN → C3 - If no valid pixels in ocean area → C2 - Valid SST range: typically -2°C to 35°C - Compare: if max SST > 23°C → A, else → B ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions la_jolla = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.27, 32.85]) buffer_region = la_jolla.buffer(5000) # 5km buffer for coastal area date = '2018-08-01' # 2. Data Acquisition - NOAA OISST sst_col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1') \ .filterDate(date, '2018-08-02') \ .filterBounds(buffer_region) # Check if data exists size = sst_col.size().getInfo() print(f"SST Images found: {size}") if size == 0: print("No SST data available for specified date.") print("C1") else: # 3. Get SST image sst_image = sst_col.first() sst_band = sst_image.select('sst') # 4. Check for valid pixels and calculate statistics stats = sst_band.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.max().combine( reducer2=ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True ), geometry=buffer_region, scale=27830, # ~25km native resolution maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() max_sst = stats.get('sst_max') pixel_count = stats.get('sst_count') print(f"Valid pixels: {pixel_count}") print(f"Max SST: {max_sst} °C") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if pixel_count == 0: print("No valid ocean pixels in region.") print("C2") elif max_sst is None or max_sst < -5 or max_sst > 40: print("Invalid SST value detected.") print("C3") elif max_sst > 23.0: print(f"SST exceeded 23°C (max: {max_sst:.2f}°C)") print("A") else: print(f"SST did not exceed 23°C (max: {max_sst:.2f}°C)") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
la_jolla = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.27, 32.85])
buffer_region = la_jolla.buffer(5000)  # 5km buffer for coastal area
date = '2018-08-01'

# 2. Data Acquisition - NOAA OISST
sst_col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1') \
    .filterDate(date, '2018-08-02') \
    .filterBounds(buffer_region)

# Check if data exists
size = sst_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"SST Images found: {size}")

if size == 0:
    print("No SST data available for specified date.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Get SST image
    sst_image = sst_col.first()
    sst_band = sst_image.select('sst')
    
    # 4. Check for valid pixels and calculate statistics
    stats = sst_band.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.max().combine(
            reducer2=ee.Reducer.count(),
            sharedInputs=True
        ),
        geometry=buffer_region,
        scale=27830,  # ~25km native resolution
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    max_sst = stats.get('sst_max')
    pixel_count = stats.get('sst_count')
    
    print(f"Valid pixels: {pixel_count}")
    print(f"Max SST: {max_sst} °C")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if pixel_count == 0:
        print("No valid ocean pixels in region.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif max_sst is None or max_sst < -5 or max_sst > 40:
        print("Invalid SST value detected.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif max_sst > 23.0:
        print(f"SST exceeded 23°C (max: {max_sst:.2f}°C)")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"SST did not exceed 23°C (max: {max_sst:.2f}°C)")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")

la_jolla = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.27, 32.85])
buffer_region = la_jolla.buffer(50000)  # 50km buffer for coastal waters

# 2. Data Acquisition - NOAA OISST

    .filterBounds(buffer_region)

    print(f"Max SST: {max_sst:.2f}°C" if max_sst is not None else "Max SST: None")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if pixel_count == 0 or pixel_count is None:
        print("No valid ocean pixels in region.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif max_sst is None or max_sst < 0 or max_sst > 40:
        print("Invalid SST value detected.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif max_sst > 23.0:
        print(f"SST exceeded 23°C")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"SST did not exceed 23°C")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
